name: current tracks
about: What is on each deck.

name: play positions
about: How far through each record is.

name: BPM
about: The tempo each deck is actually running at, pitch included.

name: beat grids
about: Where the beat is, and how sure the analysis is of it.

name: key
about: The camelot key of each record.

name: energy
about: How loud the mix is, against tonight's own range.

name: phrase structure
about: How long a phrase is and where one starts.

name: stems
about: Which of the four parts of each record are muted.

name: current transitions
about: The mix in progress, as a thing with a shape and a length.
source: a transition happens over time and the briefing is one instant. What it does carry is the crossfader and what each deck is doing, which is the evidence a transition is under way rather than the transition itself

name: cue points
about: The hot cues set on each deck.

name: loop state
about: The loop in force on each deck, if any.

name: FX
about: The effects running on each deck.

name: mixer state
about: Where the crossfader is.

name: library
about: The whole collection.
source: a collection is thousands of records and a briefing carrying it would be the database in a prompt. The assistant searches it instead, which is what a search is for

name: prepared tracks
about: What is staged and on its way to a deck.
source: staged records are the browser's and the snapshot carries what the engine has. Gathering them is a second read the briefing does not yet make

name: next candidates
about: What the rail would offer next.
source: the rail is computed from the library on demand and is not on the snapshot

name: history
about: What has already been played tonight, oldest first.

name: session plan
about: The shape of the night, as a sequence.
source: the plan is the planner's and is not on the snapshot

name: user preferences
about: What this DJ has been learnt to like.
source: the profile is §12's and is read where suggestions are ranked, not here

name: current venue/occasion
about: What the DJ declared the night to be.

name: audience context
about: What the room is doing.
source: the room reading lives with the panel that opens the camera, and stops when it closes -- so a briefing carrying it would go on claiming a room nothing is looking at

name: hardware
about: What is plugged in and what it can reach.

name: assistant posture
about: How much the DJ has allowed it to do.

name: session phase
about: Where the night is in its arc, and how sure djmanzo is.

name: recent actions
about: The last few things the DJ did.

name: current GUI focus
about: Which arrangement is on screen and what it is for.
